note: Toyota splits this into owner-level general maintenance and workshop inspection. Both are below. Intervals are not in this manual — they live in the owner's handbook supplement, which is market-specific.

items.t: Tyre pressures, checked cold with a gauge
items.hint: Manual figure is 220 kPa / 2.2 bar / 32 psi on the standard 205/55R15. Aftermarket sizes want their own number.

items.t: Tyres for cuts, damage or uneven wear
Wheel nuts for looseness or missing nuts
Wiper blades for wear or cracks
Underneath for fuel, oil, water or other leaks
All doors and the tailgate latch and lock securely
Bonnet secondary latch holds when the primary is released
All exterior and interior lights work
Warning lights and buzzers work
items.hint: An SRS light that stays on is an MOT failure — relevant if the steering wheel has been changed.

items.t: Horn
Windscreen glass for chips and cracks
Wipers and washers, including the rear
Windscreen defroster
Rear view mirror secure
Sun visors
Steering wheel free play and no unusual noise
items.hint: On a replaced wheel, also check the spiral cable has not been strained at full lock.

items.t: Seats lock in position and adjusters work
Seat belts, buckles, retractors and anchors
items.hint: Pretensioners are pyrotechnic. Do not disturb them casually.

items.t: Accelerator pedal
Brakes — pedal, handbrake, and a low-speed stop test
Washer fluid level
Engine coolant level
Radiator and hoses for damage or leaks
Battery electrolyte level
Brake and clutch fluid levels
Engine drive belts for wear and tension
Engine oil level
items.hint: A VVTL-i engine is unforgiving of a low level — the lift mechanism is hydraulic.

items.t: Power steering fluid level
items.hint: ATF DEXRON II or III, 1.0 L total.

items.t: Exhaust system for damage, leaks or loose mountings
Inspect drive belt
Replace spark plugs
Inspect air filter
Replace air filter
Replace engine oil and oil filter
items.hint: 4.4 L with an oil cooler, 4.2 L without.

items.t: Replace engine coolant
Inspect fuel lines and connections
Inspect exhaust pipes and mountings
Adjust valve clearance
items.hint: Cold: intake 0.15–0.25 mm, exhaust 0.35–0.45 mm. Shim-under-bucket, so this is a cam-out job.

items.t: Inspect brake line pipes and hoses
Inspect front brake pads and discs
items.hint: Pad min 1.0 mm. Disc 25.0 mm new, 23.0 mm scrap, runout max 0.05 mm.

items.t: Inspect rear brake pads and discs
items.hint: Pad min 1.0 mm. Disc 9.0 mm new, 7.5 mm scrap.

items.t: Inspect parking brake linings and drum
items.hint: Drum max 201.0 mm. Lever travel 5–8 clicks at 196 N.

items.t: Inspect steering linkage
Inspect steering gear housing oil
Inspect drive shaft boots
Inspect ball joints and dust covers
Replace transaxle fluid
items.hint: C60: 2.3 L, API GL-4 or GL-5, SAE 75W-90.

items.t: Tighten bolts and nuts on chassis and body

mot.why: SS-49 minimum. Below it is a fail and a disc-damaging risk.
SS-49. Only 2 mm of wear between new and scrap.
SS-49. More travel than this and the rear shoes need adjusting.

mot.t: No warning lamp illuminated with the engine running
mot.why: An SRS or ABS lamp is a straight failure. Directly relevant after a steering wheel change.

mot.t: Every exterior lamp works, correct colour, no tint on OEM lenses
mot.why: A defective lens affecting emitted light is a major defect.

mot.t: Tyres legal depth, no damage, correct speed rating
mot.why: Standard fitment is 87V. Check what is actually fitted.
A changed cluster or wheel size still has to indicate correctly.

mot.t: No sharp edges or insecure body panels
mot.why: Aftermarket kit, wings and skirts all count as bodywork.

mot.t: Seat belts latch, retract and are undamaged
mot.why: And the seats are secure — relevant after heated seat work.
